tasks.title: NeoMud Three practical reset
tasks.description: Turn the current Three.js proof of concept into a server-backed game client architecture: Kotlin server authority, normalized client game state, renderer engine, scene registry, reusable components, generated asset pipeline, gameplay surfaces, and repeatable QA.

tasks.title: Keep Kotlin server as authoritative game spine
tasks.description: Document and preserve the boundary where /game WebSocket messages own auth, current room, movement legality, NPC/player presence, inventory, combat, dialogue, tutorials, and interactables. Renderer may cache and predict but must reconcile to server messages.

comments.body: Server authority boundary is implemented in the protocol adapter and documented in memory-bank/architecture.md; preserve as an invariant.

tasks.title: Extract normalized client game state and command router
tasks.description: Create a small state store and command router so UI, physical exits, minimap, hotkeys, and future interactions dispatch to server-backed commands or explicit offline fallback through one path.

tasks.title: Extract persistent Three render engine
tasks.description: Move renderer, scene, camera rig, lights, render loop, current room group disposal, resize, and debug hooks out of app.js without changing current play behavior.

comments.body: First renderer boundary pass shipped locally: added render-engine.js for renderer/scene/camera/player/world-root/base lights/environment/resize/render stats/loop binding/room-root disposal. app.js still owns camera-follow math and debug hooks, so task remains in-progress.
Camera-follow rig math moved into render-engine.js; app.js now passes heading and room camera settings. Debug hooks and room lifecycle APIs remain in app.js, so task stays in-progress.
Room-root replacement/disposal moved behind renderEngine.replaceWorld(); app.js no longer reads or clears worldRoot directly. Debug hooks remain outside the engine, so task stays in-progress.

tasks.title: Add scene registry and RoomRenderSpec layer
tasks.description: Normalize NeoMud room data plus server overlays into render specs, then resolve room ids/kinds to scene builders through a registry instead of hard-coded if/else branches.

comments.body: Added initial scene-registry.js so app.js resolves room scenes through one registry instead of hard-coded builders; RoomRenderSpec remains next.
Added initial TOWN_SQUARE_SPEC authoring layer with surfaces, chunk rings, landmarks, props, spawns, and exit triggers so future layout changes are spec edits instead of raw mesh surgery.
Town Square exits are now explicit RoomRenderSpec-style trigger volumes validated against the real room graph.

Completed: inventory panel now renders server stacks, equipped slots, and coins; debug API exposes inventory items/coin totals; server QA verifies Inventory panel/state after live Hidden Cave pickup.

tasks.title: Add HUD pickup feedback for live loot
tasks.description: Show visible HUD feedback when server-confirmed item or coin pickup changes inventory, so live loot resolution is legible without opening the Inventory panel.

comments.body: Completed: server-confirmed pickup_result now shows a compact HUD pickup toast; debug API exposes deterministic pickup feedback state; server-backed QA asserts the toast on live pickup when loot exists and always writes server-hidden-cave-pickup.png for UI review.

tasks.title: Improve Hidden Cave wall and ceiling composition
tasks.description: Replace the flat Hidden Cave shell feel with a more believable authored chamber: layered wall ribs, ceiling silhouettes, stalactites, damp ledges, and better chest staging using existing materials only.

comments.body: Completed: Hidden Cave now adds layered wall ribs, low ceiling plates, stalactites, damp ledges, and stronger chest alcove staging using existing cave materials only. Room-shot QA, offline smoke, and server-backed QA pass; Hidden Cave budgets are 43 calls / 2,111 triangles in screenshot/offline/server runs.

tasks.title: Add in-world pickup feedback marker
tasks.description: Add a lightweight in-world confirmation effect for server-confirmed pickup_result so item/coin collection reads in the 3D view, not only in the DOM HUD.

comments.body: Completed: pickup_result now triggers a transient 3D burst over the player through render-engine.js; debug API exposes active pickup effect count; server-backed QA asserts the in-world effect and HUD toast before writing server-hidden-cave-pickup.png.

tasks.title: Improve Hidden Cave chest and loot staging
tasks.description: Improve Hidden Cave chest and loot staging so item/coin markers are easier to read around the player avatar and the chest alcove feels intentional.

comments.body: Completed: cave loot markers are spread farther around the chest, Hidden Cave item labels use raised labelY/labelZ values through the reusable item-marker API, and the coin pile moved to a clearer visible spot. Server-backed and offline smoke QA pass.

tasks.title: Improve Hidden Cave chest hero prop
tasks.description: Strengthen the moss-covered stone chest as a readable hero interactable using existing cave/town materials only: plinth, arch silhouette, straps/latch, moss glow, and better affordance staging without adding new generated assets.

comments.body: Completed: moss chest now has a wider plinth, stone alcove, side obelisks, straps/latch, moss ribbons, glowing seal, halo affordance, adjusted cave camera, and wider collision. Room-shot, offline smoke, and server-backed QA pass; Hidden Cave remains under budget at 53 calls / 2,925 triangles.

tasks.title: Improve Temple altar wall composition
tasks.description: Add a stronger Gothic apse/altar-wall composition using existing temple materials: vertical side niches, tracery, trim, and glow that reduce the blank masonry wall while preserving altar collision and QA budgets.

comments.body: Completed: Temple altar wall now has side lancet niches, vertical trim, recessed side panels, and stronger framing around the existing dawn retable. Room-shot, offline smoke, and server-backed QA pass; Temple remains under budget at 290 calls / 35,406 triangles in smoke/server QA.

tasks.title: Improve Tavern ceiling composition
tasks.description: Reduce the flat dark Tavern ceiling mass with reusable low-cost ceiling planks, rafters, and a few warm lantern accents using existing Tavern/Town materials only.

comments.body: Completed: Tavern ceiling now has instanced planks/rafters and three low-cost warm lantern accents using existing materials. Room-shot/offline/server QA pass; metrics recorded in memory bank.
